title: Protected Relay service-principal identity bundle
description: Secret-bearing schema for the offline principal provisioner and the protected Relay API. This schema deliberately contains no example secret values.

principals.$comment: Items must be in strictly increasing client_id order. client_id, tenant_id, upstream_token, derived purpose, reserved username and raw token key must each be unique under the Go parser's exact-set rules.

upstream_token.$comment: The runtime parser additionally rejects placeholders and low-diversity values. Generate this value with a cryptographically secure random source.
